claims.text: The initial material is FeCoNiCrAl high-entropy-alloy feedstock with a particle-size range of 15–45 μm.
HVAF-i7 deposition of 15–45 μm FeCoNiCrAl feedstock at standard, non-optimized spray distances produces acceptable-quality coatings with insufficient thickness.
The nozzle-specific optimum spray-distance range for the HVAF-i7 torch is approximately 300–350 mm.
Setting the HVAF-i7 spray distance to 300–350 mm will increase particle velocity.
The increased particle velocity at the proposed spray distance will increase particle kinetic energy upon impact.
Greater impact kinetic energy will enhance particle–substrate bonding.
The higher particle velocity produced by the optimized spray distance will reduce in-flight oxidation.
Optimal particle velocity will improve deposition efficiency through increased kinetic-energy transfer during impingement.
Improved deposition efficiency will produce a thicker FeCoNiCrAl bond coat.
The proposed spray-distance adjustment will produce a more adherent coating.
The proposed spray-distance adjustment will maintain minimal oxidation during deposition and subsequent high-temperature exposure.
Relative to the non-optimized HVAF-i7 baseline, deposition at 300–350 mm will yield a significantly thicker bond coat.
The thickness increase will occur without compromising coating quality or high-temperature oxidation resistance.
The intervention is expected to remain effective for deposition on components with internal diameters around 120 mm.
The intervention is expected to remain effective under high-temperature thermal-barrier service conditions.
The intervention's efficacy may be limited when substrate geometry or environmental conditions differ significantly from those tested.

contradictions.description: A 300–350 mm nozzle-to-surface spray distance is presented as applicable inside a component with an internal diameter of only about 120 mm. For conventional radial internal-diameter spraying, that stand-off cannot be accommodated geometrically; no alternative torch orientation or definition of spray distance is supplied.
